== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Han Solo (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]] (<code>1210_101</code>, Virtual Block 1 slip 99E), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-99E-Han_Solo.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-L-hansolo-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Han Solo (V) (Virtual Block 1)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip. Published typos are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Cards with 'Han' in title are destiny +3. May use 1 Force to cancel Boba Fett or Jabba's game text for remainder of turn. If opponent just initiated battle here, may use 1 Force to take the first weapons segment action.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1210_101</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 1 set mark, slip number 99E, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
